name: kibl_sweeps
sql: select sweep_id, started_at, finished_at, ok, rows_seen, rows_new, api_calls, left(note,120) note from public.kibl_sweeps order by started_at

name: kibl_ping
sql: select d.start_time, d.status, left(d.return_message,80) msg from cron.job_run_details d join cron.job j using(jobid) where j.jobname='ten232-kibl-sweep-ping' order by d.start_time

name: kibl_now_gaps
sql: select * from public.kibl_now_gaps order by gap_from

name: kibl_now_hb
sql: select card_key, side_key, kind, written_at, note from public.kibl_now_price where kind='heartbeat'

name: kibl_stream_span
sql: select min(observed_at) first, max(observed_at) last, count(*) n from public.kibl_line_observations where sweep_id='stream'

name: kibl_stream_gaps
sql: select a, b, extract(epoch from b-a)/60 mins from (select observed_at b, lag(observed_at) over (order by observed_at) a from public.kibl_line_observations where sweep_id='stream') x where b-a > interval '15 minutes' order by a

name: kibl_lastseen_171
sql: select date_trunc('hour', last_seen_at) h, count(*) from public.kibl_line_observations where feed_source_id=171 and last_seen_at > now()-interval '73 hours' group by 1 order by 1

name: at_polls
sql: select poll_id, observed_at, ok, matches, quotes, rows_written from public.ten216_test_polls order by observed_at

name: at_change_polls
sql: select poll_id, min(observed_at) t0, max(observed_at) t1, count(*) n from public.ten216_test_odds_changes group by poll_id order by 2

name: at_watch_log
sql: select at, condition, kind, channel, left(message,200) message, delivered from public.ten216_watch_log order by at

name: rec_kinds
sql: select kind, book, status_code, (note is not null) has_note, count(*), min(fired_at) first, max(fired_at) last from ten287_rec.requests group by 1,2,3,4 order by 1,2,3

name: rec_updated
sql: select book, fired_at, processed_at, status_code, left(note,60) note from ten287_rec.requests where kind='updated' order by fired_at

name: rec_sweeps
sql: select kind, fired_at, status_code from ten287_rec.requests where kind in ('events','multi') order by fired_at

name: rec_cron
sql: select d.start_time, d.status, left(d.return_message,80) msg from cron.job_run_details d join cron.job j using(jobid) where j.jobname='ten287-recorder' order by d.start_time

name: rec_ticks_span
sql: select book, min(seen_at), max(seen_at), count(*) from ten287_rec.ticks group by 1

name: op_ledger
sql: select * from public.oddspapi_budget_ledger order by created_at
